description: 20-scenario evaluation set for Prompt-to-Drive. Covers 5 weather types x 6 event types x 3 difficulty levels. Ground truth labels were established by two independent human raters inspecting rendered simulation frames (see paper Section 4.1).

scenarios.prompt: A pedestrian suddenly crosses near a traffic signal in rainy weather.
Sudden lane change to avoid a parked vehicle on a sunny highway.
A cyclist runs a red light in foggy conditions at a busy junction.
Emergency braking required when a vehicle ahead stops abruptly at night.
A parked vehicle obstructs the lane on a cloudy day, forcing a detour.
Overtaking a slow-moving truck on a clear rural road.
A pedestrian crosses at an unmarked junction during heavy rain at night.
A cyclist swerves into traffic suddenly in dense fog with low visibility.
Emergency brake test in rainy conditions with heavy traffic density.
A vehicle runs a red light at a signalized intersection in clear daylight.
Pedestrian crossing near a school zone junction on a cloudy afternoon.
A delivery vehicle obstructs a lane at night, requiring nearby traffic to merge.
Overtaking maneuver on a foggy two-lane road with oncoming traffic risk.
A cyclist crosses an intersection just as the light changes, in clear weather.
Sudden lane change due to debris on a rainy highway at night.
A pedestrian darts between parked cars into the road in clear daylight.
Emergency braking when a cyclist swerves in front of the ego vehicle, foggy morning.
A vehicle blocks an intersection after running a red light on a cloudy day.
Overtaking a cyclist on a narrow road at night with oncoming headlights.
A stalled vehicle obstructs a junction approach during light rain.
